title: The Best Locker
author: Wren Ashgrove
blurb: Theo Sandoval, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
